data.title: Finance Intern – Finance Transformation
data.description: For this U.S. based position, the expected compensation range is $22.50 - $35.50 per hour. In addition, this position is eligible for overtime pay and recognition programs. The compensation rate for this position is for candidates located within the United States. Individual pay is determined by several factors including knowledge, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. You must submit an online application to be considered for the position. The Company will accept applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. If you believe this job posting is not compliant with applicable state pay transparency laws in the U.S., please notify the Company as soon as possible upon discovery by completing this form Job Posting Compliance Form. We are seeking a highly motivated Finance Intern to support our ongoing Finance Transformation initiatives for Summer 2026. This role is ideal for a candidate who is curious, analytical, and eager to contribute to process improvements within a fast‑paced finance environment. The intern will work closely with the Finance team — including regular exposure to the CFO — to identify inefficiencies, evaluate opportunities for optimization, and support the implementation of transformative solutions. What will you do? Finance Transformation & Process Improvement Assist in evaluating existing financial processes, workflows, and systems to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities. Conduct data analysis to understand trends, root causes, and performance gaps. Support the design, documentation, and rollout of improved processes, tools, and dashboards. Benchmark best practices and assist in developing recommendations to enhance operational efficiency and financial accuracy. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with Finance teams (FP&A, Accounting, Costing, Plant Finance, etc.) to gather insights, understand pain points, and build improvement proposals. Coordinate with other business functions as needed to collect data or validate proposed improvements. Executive Support and Feasibility Studies Work directly with the CFO to support strategic finance transformation initiatives. Conduct feasibility studies, cost–benefit analysis, and scenario modeling for proposed changes or projects. Prepare presentations, executive summaries, and analysis to support leadership decision‑making. Reporting & Analytics Assist in creating visual reports, performance trackers, and dashboards for monitoring transformation progress. Help maintain documentation of process changes, standard operating procedures, and project plans. What's in it for you? Hands-on experience working on high-impact finance transformation initiatives. Direct exposure to senior leadership, including the CFO. Practical skills in financial analysis, change management, and continuous improvement. Opportunity to influence real organizational change and contribute to strategic decisions What qualifications will make you successful for this role? Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present findings effectively. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with Power BI or similar analytical tools is a plus. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Interest in process improvement, digital transformation, and modern finance tools. Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or process‑optimization concepts. Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Acumaticaor similar). Prior internship or project experience in finance or data analytics. Must be able to work onsite in the Buffalo, NY area Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, ongoing basis. data.title: Alternant(e) Technicien(ne) d’Intervention - BTS Electrotechnique - Villepinte - F/H
data.description: Vous souhaitez préparer un BTS ou une Licence Électrotechnique en alternance ? Votre futur métier : entretenir, moderniser, dépanner les postes électriques de nos clients Accompagné(e) par votre tuteur, vous réaliserez des interventions (planifiées ou non) de maintenance des postes électriques (HTA) en respectant les critères de sécurité et de qualité pour la satisfaction de nos clients. Vous serez également en charge de préparer les interventions, de les réaliser avec rigueur, de vérifier les travaux effectués et de rédiger les rapports d’intervention. Des déplacements très fréquents sont à prévoir. Transfo Services, filiale du groupe Schneider Electric, est le spécialiste de la Maintenance des postes de transformation électrique toutes marques. Quelles sont les qualifications qui vous permettront de réussir ? Bac Pro Electrotechnique Vous êtes admis en BTS ou une Licence Electrotechnique Poste basé à Villepinte, avec des déplacements très fréquents (80% du temps) à prévoir dans la moitié Nord de la France. Pris en charge par l'entreprise Vous êtes le ou la candidate idéal(e) si : Vous souhaitez préparer un BTS Électrotechnique ou une Licence en alternance Vous êtes diplômé d'un Bac S toutes spécialités ; Bac STI2D (STI), Bac Pro MELEC Vous avez envie d’apprendre, de développer vos compétences grâce aux membres plus expérimentés de l’équipe Vous avez envie d’intervenir chez nos clients et donc de se déplacer en toute autonomie (permis B obligatoire) Vous avez le sens de l’organisation (définir ses priorités…) et de réalisation (mettre en œuvre, aller au bout des interventions) Durée du contrat : en fonction du profil 12 ou 24 mois Schneider Electric participe, dans certains cas, aux frais de déplacement ou d'hébergement engendrés par l'éloignement entre l'école et le lieu d'accueil en entreprise. Schneider Electric favorise la diversité et recrute sans discrimination. Merci de joindre à votre candidature vos bulletins de notes des 2 dernières années ainsi qu’une lettre de motivation. En intégrant Schneider Electric en tant qu'Alternant, en plus d’une expérience professionnelle et personnelle enrichissante, vous bénéficierez : D’un package salarial attractif et compétitif : salaire supérieur au minimum légal, intéressement et participation, prime de réussite à l’examen de 1000€ D’une participation aux frais de transport en commun à hauteur de 75% D’une aide à la mobilité : en fonction de votre situation d’éloignement, nous vous proposons une participation aux frais de transport (train/avion/voiture/bus) ou frais kilométriques ou une aide « double résidence » jusqu’à 550€ par mois D’autres avantages : un accès au restaurant d’entreprise ou ticket restaurant pour les sites ne disposant pas de restaurant d’entreprise, un accompagnement à la mobilité internationale si obligatoire dans le cursus, 5 jours de congés « préparation aux examens » rémunérés pour tous, des activités culturelles et sportives, des dispositifs d’aides sociales si besoin pendant votre contrat. et pour en savoir plus sur notre politique Diversité et Inclusion France : https://www.se.com/fr/fr/about-us/diversity-and-inclusion/ Prochaines étapes de notre processus de sélection : Votre candidature sera étudiée par le recruteur Si votre profil correspond aux prérequis, vous serez contacté pour effectuer un entretien de préqualification avec le recruteur ou un entretien Vidéo via la plateforme HireVue Si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager / tuteur pour un entretien. A noter que vous pouvez suivre à tout moment le statut de votre candidature via votre tableau de bord candidat sur le site carrières de Schneider Electric. Chez Schneider Electric, nos valeurs et nos comportements sont le fondement de la création d'une culture d'entreprise qui contribue à la réussite de l'entreprise. Nous pensons que nos valeurs IMPACT - Inclusion, Maîtrise, Raison d'Etre, Action, Curiosité, Travail d'équipe - commencent avec nous. IMPACT est également une invitation à rejoindre une entreprise où vous pourrez contribuer à transformer l'ambition du développement durable en action, quelle que soit votre fonction dans l'entreprise. Nous recherchons des IMPACT Makers, des personnes exceptionnelles qui transforment les ambitions de développement durable en actions à l'intersection de l'automatisation, de l'électrification et de la digitalisation. Nous célébrons les IMPACT Makers et pensons que chacun a le potentiel d'en être un. data.description: • Be responsible for the testing and verification of power converter products and new DC distribution systems. Formulate and maintain verification and testing plans and schemes for R&D projects at different stages. • Execution testing mainly in electrical, firmware, EMC, safety, reliability, components of multi-type test task, identify and report issues, and support designers in troubleshooting. • Process, analyze and interpret test data to pinpoint potential risks and performance bottlenecks; deliver high-quality test reports & summaries, maintain the defect database. • Partner closely with the R&D team to root-cause test-identified issues, track progress and drive defect closure. • Ensure agile and cost-effective test execution aligned with project delivery timelines • Contribute to the development roadmap of the new lab, advance its automation and digital transformation. • Establish the R&D test case database and streamlined test workflows to achieve end-to-end test coverage. • Mentor junior technical engineers. • Located in Jiangsu Wuxi 资格 Qualifications: • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering & Automation or related disciplines. • 3~5 years of testing experience in power conversion products (PCS, UPS, driver etc.); • In-depth knowledge of the working principles, system architecture and key parameters of converter systems, as well as familiarity with power electronic topologies. • Proficiency in testing methodologies and equipment operation for power converters such as AC/DC, DC/DC etc. • Knowledge of functions and standards for power conversion related products, e.g. IEC62477-1, UL1741, GB/T34120/34133, IEC60068 series, EN50549, VDE4105/4110. • Strong team spirit, open-mindedness and the ability to build trust within teams. • Excellent execution capacity to drive project progress in fast-changing environments. • Flexibility for short-distance business trips. • Proficiency in using LabVIEW or robot framework to build an automated testing platform is preferred. • Fluent in English and Chinese. 时间表: 全职 请求编号: 009JY5

data.title: Export Control and Sanctions, MEA Zone Leader
data.description: The Export Control and Sanctions Zone Leader is responsible for leading and implementing Schneider Electric’s export control and sanctions compliance program within the assigned Zone. The role ensures effective deployment of required processes and controls at the cluster and country level, provides expert regulatory guidance, and partners closely with Zone leadership and business stakeholders. This position reports directly to the Vice President, Export Control and Sanctions, and works in close coordination with other Zone Leaders and the Global Program Leader to ensure consistent application of the Group’s compliance framework. Key Responsibilities: Program Implementation & Oversight Lead the implementation and execution of Schneider Electric’s export control and sanctions compliance program across the Zone. Monitor applicable export control and sanctions regulations, assess regulatory changes, and ensure timely communication and integration into Zone processes. Develop a strong understanding of Zone business models and operational processes to effectively embed compliance requirements. Serve as a trusted advisor to Zone leadership and business stakeholders on export control and sanctions matters. Leadership & People Management Manage and develop a team responsible for Zone‑level export control and sanctions activities, including transaction reviews and escalations. Foster technical expertise and regulatory awareness within the team through coaching, guidance, and capability development. Promote a strong culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the Zone. Risk Management & Escalations Manage escalations related to export control clauses and compliance risks. Act as the primary point of contact for export control and sanctions matters with relevant government authorities at the Zone level. Support and/or lead compliance reviews and audits at Schneider Electric entities and oversee implementation of resulting corrective and improvement actions. Training & Awareness In coordination with the Export Control and Sanctions Program, deliver regular training for Zone employees at all levels. Provide targeted training and regulatory updates to employees with export control and sanctions responsibilities (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Finance). Coordination & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Zone Legal teams on contractual, regulatory, and compliance‑related matters. Support export control classification questions and escalations, coordinating with the Export Control Classification Team as required. Support screening questions and escalations, coordinating with the Export Control and Sanctions Screening Team as required. Validate export control testing and assessments for Zone entities in coordination with the global Program team and support development of action plans where needed. Prepare and present periodic compliance updates, metrics, and reports related to Zone export control and sanctions activities. data.title: Warehouse Operations Intern
data.description: At Schneider Electric Hub Asia, we keep the region’s supply chain moving. As a global leader in energy management and automation, we are committed to enabling efficiency, sustainability, and reliability across industries. Our Hub Asia Distribution Center is a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment that powers customer deliveries across the region. Here, we’re not just running a warehouse—we’re building the supply chain of the future. From Lean transformation to digitalisation and automation, we’re constantly innovating to deliver excellence for our customers. We’re a team that values ownership, teamwork, continuous improvement, and a strong sense of purpose. If you enjoy solving real operational challenges, working at the heart of the supply chain, and contributing to meaningful transformation, you’ll feel right at home with us. Why Join Us? At Schneider Electric Hub Asia, you’ll play more than just an operational role—you’ll help shape how future-ready warehouses run. Here’s what you can expect: Purpose with Impact We manage mission-critical operations that directly influence customer experience across Asia. You’ll be part of the core team ensuring seamless flow of materials, high service levels, and operational excellence. Real Growth Expect steep learning, hands-on experience, and opportunities to lead improvements. This isn’t a place for maintaining the status quo—you’ll be empowered to drive lean initiatives, streamline processes, and support automation adoption on the shopfloor. Culture that Values People We believe in teamwork, trust, transparency, and learning by doing. We celebrate continuous improvement, challenge the norm respectfully, and support each other to succeed. If you enjoy learning fast, improving systems, and shaping how operations work behind the scenes—you’ll thrive here. About the Role Love logistics, solving operational problems, and making things run smoother? As a Warehouse Operations Intern, you’ll work closely as a buddy to the Warehouse Supervisor, gaining full mastery of end-to-end warehouse operations. You’ll be handson in driving lean processes, efficiency improvements, and automation adoption initiatives, while ensuring day-to-day operations run with precision. This role offers unique exposure to distribution center operations, SAP/WM systems, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement projects within a dynamic hub environment. Location: Tuas What will you do? You’ll support and enhance daily warehouse operations, including: Operational Excellence Work side-by-side with the Warehouse Supervisor to understand, manage, and improve end-to-end warehouse processes. Drive lean initiatives, 5S, cycle-time reduction, and continuous improvement activities. Support automation adoption and digital transformation projects on the shopfloor. Order & Capacity Management Coordinate and prioritize orders to meet On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets. Plan warehouse capacity and resources to ensure operational readiness. Act as an escalation point for urgent or critical customer orders. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate with internal teams—including planning, transport, customer service, and quality—to resolve operational issues. Liaise with customer representatives/agents for urgent tasks and time-sensitive requests. System & Process Support Troubleshoot SAP/WM issues and work with the digital team to resolve system gaps. Ensure warehouse documentation, transactions (e.g., FIFO, MIGO), and processes meet accuracy and compliance standards. Continuous Improvement Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across operations. Provide feedback to IPL (Industrial Performance & Lean) and support process improvement project implementation. What qualifications will make you successful for this role? Qualifications & Experience Diploma or higher in Logistics or Supply Chain Management (or related field). Solid understanding of warehouse operations and terminology (e.g., FIFO, MIGO). Familiar with inventory management and transportation workflows. Computer literate; SAP & Warehouse Management (WM) experience is a plus. Good communication skills in English. Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, hands-on approach. You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Are: Curious and eager to understand how things work (and how they can work better) A self-starter who enjoys being on the shopfloor and solving real operational challenges. Detail-oriented, organized, and consistent in follow-through. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities. A true team player who collaborates well across functions. What you'll gain: Deep, hands-on understanding of end-to-end warehouse operations in a global supply chain environment. Practical experience in lean methodology, efficiency improvement, and automation projects. Exposure to SAP/WM systems and data-driven processes.
